params.text:
Nine men's morris brain (side X vs program O)
Opening (placing):
- Prefer junction points 5, 11, 14, 20 (4 neighbours): more mobility.
- Before each move check: can O complete a mill next turn? If yes, block it. Can I complete one? Do it.
- Build double threats: two pieces on different lines sharing an empty point, so one placement makes two open pairs.
- Don't scatter on corners early; keep pieces able to move.
- When I close a mill, remove an O piece that is part of an O two-in-row threat, or one that blocks my mill lines. Pieces in mills can't be removed unless all are.
Movement phase:
- Keep mobility; avoid getting blocked (no legal move = loss).
- Aim for a mill that can open and close (a piece oscillating between two lines).
- Always check O's closing moves after my move.
- Draw rules: 3-fold repetition, 40 turns with no mill. Avoid repeating if ahead.
- With 3 pieces left I can jump: watch for O's double threats and block the mill.
Process: viewBoard, proposeMove, then playMove with the same number. Notes after game: record what the program does (is it greedy/blocking?) and update here.
